notes.title: 聆花系列正传第四部《南栀 Unwavering love》即将发售
notes.notes:
经过漫长的修整与等待，聆花系列大结局终于将与大家见面。
感谢各位玩家在这么多年里的支持与厚爱，希望《南栀 Unwavering love》能够为本系列画上一个完美的句号。
在此之后，我们还会做出更多更好的百合游戏来回馈一直支持着我们的玩家朋友！

notes.title: Melancholy Love - English Version Now Available
notes.notes:
[b]Melancholy Love is now available in English at a 15% discount!
[/b]

Melancholy Love is now fully localized into English by our English publisher, Kikai Digital. You can buy the game at its English Store Page from the link below:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1387460/Melancholy_Love/

Melancholy Love is a coming-of-age yuri visual novel set in a private girls' academy. It's a romantic journey that follows an elite student born to privilege and a delinquent who wishes to break free from the chains of the academy.

How will sparks fly between these two people from different worlds? Will their love overcome all obstacles or will their differences be too great and drive them apart?
